formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P20 — Independent-Fresh Cohort Effect-Size Heterogeneity, P17↔P19 Frozen HYBRID Complementarity Transport, Solve-Bootstrap Cohort-Difference Estimation, Fresh96 Descriptive Pooling, Era×Method×Reconstructor Interaction Stability & Successor-Contact Necessity Audit

evidence_boundary.p17_role: independent fresh48 for P16 HAND-vs-RAW primary; HYBRID secondary, development-only after P17
evidence_boundary.p19_role: independent untouched fresh48 primary HYBRID-vs-HAND confirmation attempt
evidence_boundary.p20_role: post-result heterogeneity audit only; no fresh confirmation authority

cohort_difference.interpretation: CI excluding zero supports fresh-cohort effect-size nonstationarity; CI crossing zero leaves magnitude instability unresolved

pooled_fresh96.authority: descriptive only because P17 generated the hybrid successor rival

interaction_stability.requirements: report all level-wise deltas and sign concordance; do not select a favorable subgroup
interaction_stability.era_localization_test: compare early E1/E2 versus late E3/E4 cohort-difference means descriptively

adjudication.STABLE_DIRECTION_VARIABLE_MAGNITUDE: both cohort aggregate effects favor HYBRID; cohort-difference CI may or may not exclude zero; subgroup sign ownership is not uniform
adjudication.EFFECT_SIZE_NONSTATIONARY: cohort-difference 90% bootstrap interval excludes zero in either direction
adjudication.STABLE_COMPLEMENTARITY_SURFACE: cohort-difference 90% interval includes zero AND at least 2/3 named axes have all level-wise cohort-difference signs mixed around zero without a consistent localized displacement
adjudication.HETEROGENEITY_LOCALIZED: one named axis shows a coherent level-structured displacement that explains the aggregate cohort difference, while other axes do not
adjudication.SUPPORT_LIMITED: either fresh cohort has fewer than 48 solve-level rows or required metadata levels are absent

successor_rule.default_if_nonstationary: do not spend more fresh contact on the same aggregate HYBRID-vs-HAND contrast; either freeze a localized successor rival prospectively or return to another evidence reservoir
successor_rule.default_if_stable_surface: only then consider whether a larger untouched sample has enough information value to test the same frozen contrast

forbidden: change subgroup axes after reading solve-level results
treat pooled fresh96 as independent confirmation
use subgroup discovery to retroactively rescue P19
